text.offer: Before you head out to the rats, a word of advice. There is an old portal at the edge of town, shimmering away to itself. Walk into it, and it will know you: wherever you find another like it, you can step back here. Every traveller should have a way home.
text.complete: There, now Raza is never more than a step away. Mind you come back and spend your coin here.

steps.brief: Find the portal at the edge of Raza (a gold "!" marks portals you haven't touched) and walk into it to attune yourself to it.
